title: Security Laboratory Personnel Skill Taxonomy
description: Comprehensive competency taxonomy for a full-spectrum security laboratory, aligned with ISO 17025 competence management principles.

proficiency_model.name: Dreyfus-ISO17025 Hybrid

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Can describe concepts; has completed awareness training.
default_evidence: Completed relevant awareness or introductory training
Can explain the concept to a non-technical audience

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Performs tasks under supervision; work output reviewed by authorized personnel.
default_evidence: Completed hands-on lab exercises or training
Performed tasks under supervision on real engagements
Work reviewed and approved by authorized personnel

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Works independently; has passed proficiency assessment and received formal authorization.

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex cases; mentors others; reviews work of junior personnel.

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Recognized authority; develops methods; publishes research; trains teams.
default_evidence: Published research, CVEs, or novel techniques
Develops lab methodology and training materials
Recognized as internal or external expert
Trains teams and leads technical direction

proficiency_model.authorization_note: Authorization (level 3+) is a separate, explicit management decision — not just reaching a proficiency threshold. This follows ISO 17025 Clause 6.2.5(e).

framework_versions.nice: NICE Framework Components v2.2.0 — tks are v2 K/S statement IDs; work_roles are "<Work Role ID> <name>"

relationship_types.description: Hard prerequisite — must be mastered before this skill. Inverse (required_by) is computed by tooling.
Soft suggestion — beneficial but not blocking. Inverse (recommended_for) is computed by tooling.
